title: Build the Record for a Moved Start
subtitle: Capture the amended start and flag it
scenario: The amended offer is profiled. Build Sam Rivera's onboarding record with the AMENDED start date, and flag that the start moved so downstream steps recompute rather than trust a cached plan.
input: From the offer profile: new hire Sam Rivera (hire id H-4022), role Logistics Coordinator, department Operations, amended start date SD (moved earlier from SD+2), reports to the Hiring Manager. The start was amended, so record startDateAmended = true.
instructions: Capture the hire id and name.
Set startDate to the amended SD and startDateAmended to true.
Return one valid JSON object, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Build one JSON onboarding record: hireId, name, role, department, startDate (SD), and startDateAmended (boolean true, since the start moved).
successMessage: Record built with the amended start flagged. Downstream steps will recompute, not cache.
editorHelper: Capture the amended start and flag that it moved.

intro.heading: Before you provision: record the move

sections.title: The record is still the master
sections.body: Every branch reads this record. If it holds the amended start and flags the move, the whole run works to the right day - one wrong date here propagates everywhere.

sections.title: Flag the amendment
sections.body: startDateAmended is not decoration. It tells the plan and gate that any cached deadline is stale and must be recomputed from the new start.

sections.title: Copy exactly
sections.body: Role and department still match the catalog spelling so the plan can look the role up - the mess is the date, not the role.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A master record with the authoritative start and an amendment flag the recompute depends on.

fieldGuide.meaning: The department the role sits in.

fieldGuide.hint: It moved, so the boolean true.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd update the hire's row with the new start date and a note that it changed, so nobody works to the old day.

bestFit.how: a Set Variable module minting the hire record once, so every branch reads the same start date
build the record with the start date as a real date object, not a string to re-parse later

takeaway.heading: Record built
points: You captured the amended start as the authoritative date.
startDateAmended flags the move so the plan recomputes, not caches.
Role and department still match the catalog for lookup.
One master record carries the mess cleanly to every branch.
The workflow can now provision correctly even when the start date moves.
